title: ANY GUN ON ANY KEY
why: The four-gun belt, build 5 (his order of 2026-10-09: the player can load up the belt with all guns or whatever else they want). In a raid a gun in his hands dragged off a gun key onto keys 5 to 9 was refused with GUN KEYS ONLY. Now it is bound there as his own key and saved in his belt plan; what he had on that key goes to the key the gun came from, and the gun key it left shows the next gun as usual. And decision D2: an empty gun key 3 or 4 refused anything but a gun (GUNS ONLY); an item from the backpack dropped there now takes it, like any other key.
now: In a raid a gun goes on any key, and an item can go on an empty gun key 3 or 4.
